title: Norix SMP
description: Lifesteal,PvP,Economy,Donut-style Plugins. If your on Bedrock check the Description
body:
Norix SMP is a Minecraft server with Java × Bedrock compatibility. We offer an economy plugin system and a crate system that, don’t worry, can be earned through normal gameplay. Team up with your friends to become the richest, or fight in our PvP arenas to become the best.


If you are on Bedrock Edition join through our friend bot: Add "norixsmp" Then join that friend
